mapper.select: select uc.id, uc.batch_id as batchId, cb.name as batchName, cb.description, cb.coupon_type as couponType, cb.benefit_text as benefitText, uc.status, uc.claimed_at as claimedAt, uc.used_at as usedAt, cb.expire_time as expireTime from user_coupon uc inner join coupon_batch cb on cb.id = uc.batch_id where uc.user_id = #{userId} order by uc.claimed_at desc, uc.id desc

select uc.id, uc.batch_id as batchId, cb.name as batchName, cb.description, cb.coupon_type as couponType, cb.benefit_text as benefitText, uc.status, uc.claimed_at as claimedAt, uc.used_at as usedAt, cb.expire_time as expireTime from user_coupon uc inner join coupon_batch cb on cb.id = uc.batch_id where uc.id = #{id} and uc.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
